$comment: W46 G0: the ONE label grammar of W46's candidates, read by build-candidate.ts (the pattern a label must
match) and by search.py (how a point is named). The tracker's W45 entry: search.py marked a receded leaf
with an upper-case R, which the builder's [a-z0-9.-] refused, so stage 2 could not build its first point.
Here the marks and the pattern are stated once, both are lower-case, and test_fit.py builds a label of
every slot and leaf through the real builder. No short name begins with the receded mark and none is a prefix of another, so a
label part reads back to one (slot, leaf).
`scales`: the scale each leaf acts at (`rampAtScale` anchors every 1x/2x pair and the 2x-only leaves),
read by fit.py's scale-separable rendering: a point renders each scale through its scale twin, the
candidate of its overrides restricted to the leaves acting there. A leaf with no entry refuses. Exact
only under the anchoring, which the ladders verify (every lever rendered at both scales, the scale it
does not act at byte-identical to the control's).
